label: Specification for: VALIDATION_COUNTRYCODE_STANDARD
description: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the dwc:countryCode is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if dwc:countryCode can be unambiguously interpreted as a valid ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 country code in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "ISO 3166 Country Codes" {[https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html]} {ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 Country Code search [https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search]}
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the dwc:countryCode is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if dwc:countryCode can be unambiguously interpreted as a valid ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 country code in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT
authoritiesDefaults: bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "ISO 3166 Country Codes" {[https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html]} {ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 Country Code search [https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search]}
example1: dwc:countryCode="GL": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:countryCode is a valid ISO (ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 country codes) value"
example2: dwc:countryCode="GRL": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=NOT_COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:countryCode is NOT a valid ISO (ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 country codes) value"
